answers: issue-acceptance finding 1: done — The design now fully addresses the RQFROM-4 violation. The build stage's implementation introduced two problems: (a) a `skip_restore=false` path in `_runner_from_stage_preflight` allowing `--from-stage` without `--resume` for any state, and (b) a narrowed pre-auto-resume guard (`status=interrupted` only) that let `in_progress` states bypass rejection, reach the `auto_resume` elif, and set `resume_mode=true` before the final guard could fire. I updated: (1) Gap 12 description — explicitly says "no status narrowing — guard fires for ALL states" and "remove `skip_restore=false` (dead code per RQFROM-4)"; (2) the Gap 12 step — now says "full, un-narrowed guard" with no `[[ "$_fsg_status" == "interrupted" ]]` condition; (3) the from-stage-rehydrate-test.sh step — added item (5): update S5 (the `--from-stage` without `--resume` with `in_progress` state sub-case) to use `--resume --from-stage cyc`; (4) Decision paragraph — same clarification; (5) DSFSTG-1 Given/When — changed to `--resume --from-stage <s>` for clarity; (6) added Finding 33. DSFSTG-4 remains `[done]` — the base code had the guard correct (verified at runner.sh lines 1736-1741); the branch introduced the regression; the corrected Gap 12 step restores it.

issue-acceptance finding 2: not mine — No requirement in RQRESU-*, RQFROM-*, RQADR-*, RQHYDR-*, RQLOOP-*, RQPATH-*, or RQGUAR-* names run-status-text.sh or its rendering behaviour. The design's scope, steps, and acceptance blocks do not include run-status-text.sh. The build stage added this change and its tests (run-status-comment-render-test.sh etc.) without a requirement. The design cannot fix an out-of-scope code change — the build stage must revert it.

lens-correctness-code finding 2: wrong — DSCMBR-1's contract specifies the scenario where `build` is complete and `test` is aborted within iter k. The test correctly exercises that scenario. The all-complete-in-iter edge case the finding describes is a different scenario not named by any requirement in this issue. The design need not change.

lens-correctness-design finding 1: wrong — The design fully addresses this in Gap 11, the Decision paragraph ("also set `resume_mode=false` immediately"), and DSFSTG-3[code] (3-unit fixture [intake, cyc, verify] with all three marked complete, invoked `--resume --from-stage cyc`, asserts `verify` still dispatches — fails on old code, passes after the Gap 11 fix). Both dispatch-unit arms in `main()` in runner.sh must set `resume_mode=false` immediately after clearing `skip_until_stage`. This is fully specified and needs no design change.
